pairs: Has God driven away his people? Let it not be so!
Nam et ego Israëlita sum ex semine Abraham,
too, am an Israelite of the offspring of Abraham,
God has not driven away his people,
An nescitis in Elia quid dicit Scriptura?
And do you not know what Scripture says in Elijah,
how he calls upon God against Israel?
and they are seeking my life.”
Sed quid dicit illi divinum responsum?
But what is the Divine response to him?
“I have retained for myself seven thousand men,
qui non curvaverunt genua ante Baal.
who have not bent their knees before Baal.”
Sic ergo et in hoc tempore reliquiæ secundum electionem gratiæ salvæ factæ sunt.
Therefore, in the same way, again in this time, there is a remnant that has been saved in accord with the choice of grace.
And if it is by grace,
then it is not now by works;
alioquin gratia jam non est gratia.
otherwise grace is no longer free.
But the elect have obtained it. And truly,
“God has given them a spirit of reluctance:
and ears that do not hear,
“Let their table become like a snare,
Let their eyes be obscured, so that they may not see,
and so that they may bow down their backs always.”
Numquid sic offenderunt ut caderent? Absit.
Have they stumbled in such a way that they should fall? Let it not be so!
salus est gentibus ut illos æmulentur.
salvation is with the Gentiles, so that they may be a rival to them.
Quod si delictum illorum divitiæ sunt mundi,
Now if their offense is the riches of the world,
and if their diminution is the riches of the Gentiles,
how much more is their fullness?
For I say to you Gentiles:
Quamdiu quidem ego sum gentium Apostolus,
Certainly, as long as I am an Apostle to the Gentiles,
si quomodo ad æmulandum provocem carnem meam,
in such a way that I might provoke to rivalry those who are my own flesh,
et salvos faciam aliquos ex illis.
and so that I may save some of them.
Si enim amissio eorum, reconciliatio est mundi:
For if their loss is for the reconciliation of the world,
quæ assumptio, nisi vita ex mortuis?
what could their return be for, except life out of death?
For if the first-fruit has been sanctified,
And if the root is holy,
Quod si aliqui ex ramis fracti sunt,
And if some of the branches are broken,
and you become a partaker of the root and of the fatness of the olive tree,
do not glorify yourself above the branches.
you do not support the root,
Fracti sunt rami ut ego inserar.
The branches were broken off, so that I might be grafted on.
They were broken off because of unbelief.
So do not choose to savor what is exalted,
Si enim Deus naturalibus ramis non pepercit:
For if God has not spared the natural branches,
perhaps also he might not spare you.
Vide ergo bonitatem, et severitatem Dei:
So then, notice the goodness and the severity of God.
Certainly, toward those who have fallen,
but toward you, there is the goodness of God,
if you remain in goodness. Otherwise,
you also will be cut off.
if they do not remain in unbelief,
potens est enim Deus iterum inserere illos.
For God is able to graft them on again.
Nam si tu ex naturali excisus es oleastro,
So if you have been cut off from the wild olive tree, which is natural to you,
et contra naturam insertus es in bonam olivam:
and, contrary to nature, you are grafted on to the good olive tree,
quanto magis ii qui secundum naturam inserentur suæ olivæ?
how much more shall those who are the natural branches be grafted on to their own olive tree?
For I do not want you to be ignorant,
mysterium hoc (ut non sitis vobis ipsis sapientes), quia cæcitas ex parte contigit in Israël,
brothers, of this mystery (lest you seem wise only to yourselves) that a certain blindness has occurred in Israel,
until the fullness of the Gentiles has arrived.
et sic omnis Israël salvus fieret,
all of Israel may be saved,
“From Zion shall arrive he who delivers,
and he shall turn impiety away from Jacob.
Et hoc illis a me testamentum:
And this will be my covenant for them,
when I will take away their sins.”
they are enemies for your sake.
secundum electionem autem, carissimi propter patres.
But according to the election, they are most beloved for the sake of the fathers.
Sine pœnitentia enim sunt dona et vocatio Dei.
For the gifts and the call of God are without regret.
Sicut enim aliquando et vos non credidistis Deo,
And just as you also, in times past,
nunc autem misericordiam consecuti estis propter incredulitatem illorum:
did not believe in God, but now you have obtained mercy because of their unbelief,
ita et isti nunc non crediderunt in vestram misericordiam:
so also have these now not believed, for your mercy,
so that they might obtain mercy also.
Conclusit enim Deus omnia in incredulitate,
For God has enclosed everyone in unbelief,
so that he may have mercy on everyone.
the depths of the richness of the wisdom and knowledge of God!
and how unsearchable are his ways!
For who has known the mind of the Lord?
Or who has been his counselor?
Or who first gave to him,
so that repayment would be owed?
and in him are all things.
To him is glory, for all eternity.
